author: Sebby_Nic
body:
Hi

Can I please appeal the ban that I got over a year ago?  I was new to Minecraft then and I didn't have a full understanding of what you were allowed to do.  I have been playing for a while now and I won't make the mistake again.

My IGN is Sebby_Nic
Thank you!
